thread:
deploy-bot: AUTO-ROLLBACK: Release r2.7.1 -> rolling back canary traffic due to error-rate spike > 2% and embed-service 5xxs. Trigger: deploy-health-checks. Details: https://deploy.logs/abc123 :rotating_light:

sophia: seeing spike on dashboard — p50 ok but embeddings error rate up. thanks bot. @oncall can you validate?

oncall: jumping in. pulling logs now. ETA 3m

marco: don't immediately revert prod routes — this is only canary. what's the rollback plan? automated rollback will switch to v2.7.0? we had pin at v2.6.4 for some customers

deploy-bot: Rollback command executed: `rb --target canary --from r2.7.1 --to r2.6.4` -> initiated. Status: 20% traffic moved back. (reaction :rotating_light:)

dana: wait hold — the canary cluster uses kv-cache v1.3. The 5xxs look like cache invalidation bug. If we flip back to 2.6.4 we might bypass it, but we need to check session migrations. @alex any objections to pausing at 20% and investigating?

alex: agree pause. set `rb --pause` and notify SRE. I'll open a short investigation thread. Also mark release as 'paused-rollback' in release notes.

oncall: ran `kubectl logs` snippet shows repeated error `ERR: kvcache: missing key length`  — stacktrace attached in logs. Reproduced on canary pod-7.

sophia: if we pause, we should pin dedicated nodes for enterprise customers to avoid any drift. Notify CS.

sam: I can send a customer comm if we decide to escalate. What's the ETA to full rollback vs patch?

marco: short term: keep rollback paused at 20%, start hotfix branch `hotfix/kvcache-guard-2.7.2`. If fix < 2 hours, prefer patch; if >2h then finish rollback to 2.6.4 and communicate. Agree?

dana: yes. I'll start PR. Steps: 1) add guard check, 2) quick unit tests, 3) canary patch to 2 pods, 4) validate metrics. I'll request review from alex and sophia.

deploy-bot: Manual action required: `rb --resume` to continue or `rb --abort` to cancel rollback. Current status: PAUSED at 20%.

alex: adding to on-call runbook: if paused >30m and errors persist escalate to Eng SRE and set customer-exposure flag.

oncall: 30s: patch branch created at https://git/repo/commit/abcde. Kicking off CI. If CI passes I'll smoke test in staging then patch canary.

sophia: Customer comm draft: short note to affected customers about transient errors and mitigation steps. @sam can you prep quick note for priority accounts?

sam: on it. Draft will mention fallback to older model if we rollback fully. Will share in #customer-success for review.

dana: CI passed. canary patch deployed to 2 pods. monitoring alerts quieting on those pods. Rolling forward patch to remaining canary pods.

deploy-bot: PATCH-ROLLFORWARD: canary now on r2.7.2-hotfix, health checks green. Rolling paused rollback aborted automatically. Final status: canary healthy -> no further rollback.

marco: GL. follow-up: create postmortem, check why kv-cache guard wasn't in earlier tests, add regression test to canary suite.

alex: I'll create the release note update and closure. Thanks all :thumbsup:
